labels.caption: Fidelity of the fluid routing model for Sublet and its baselines: each policy's cost over Sublet's in the same cell (overflow accounting), in the fluid model (x) and replayed request by request (y), logarithmic scales. (a) The request-level instance's Azure 2024 conversation week at $\mu=\tilde{\beta}$, one point per tier (S, M, L), smoothing window (5, 15 and 60 min) and alignment (1--4); (b) the Mooncake conversation hour (tier M), one point per window, without and (c) with prefix hits. In the shaded quadrants the replay reverses a policy's order with Sublet; on the dashed diagonal the ratio is unchanged. The fluid and replayed orders of Sublet, critical-ratio renting, RetroRenting-style and Greedy, back-off agree in 18 of 36 cells of (a); Sublet costs less than both Greedy, back-off and RetroRenting-style in 29 of the 36 cells in the fluid model and in 23 replayed.
